name: ADJUSTED_EARNING
description: Adjustments made to an Associate's earnings. Adjustments can be for retroactive pay, reimbursement for overwithheld taxes, or other corrections to include negative adjustments.

name: ADJUSTED_EARNING_SUBTYPE
description: This is a code for the types of adjusted earnings.  Examples: - Retroactive pay - Reimbursement for overwithheld taxes - Other corrections including negative adjustments

name: AFTER_TAX_DEDUCTION
description: For an ASSOCIATE PAYROLL TRANSACTION, deductions from earnings reduce amounts paid to an ASSOCIATE. AFTER TAX DEDUCTIONs are types of reductions made from payroll payments after income taxes are calculated.  Examples of AFTER TAX DEDUCTIONs include: - Savings plan – after-tax contributions - Charita

name: AFTER_TAX_DEDUCTION_SUBTYPE
description: This is a code for the types and descriptions of after-tax deductions.  Examples: - Savings plan – after-tax contributions - Charitable contributions (i.e., United Way)

name: BEFORE_TAX_DEDUCTION
description: For an ASSOCIATE PAYROLL TRANSACTION, deductions from earnings reduce amounts paid to an ASSOCIATE. BEFORE TAX DEDUCTIONs are types of reductions made from payroll payments before income taxes are calculated. BEFORE TAX DEDUCTIONs may not be subject to income taxes, as in medical insurance costs, or

name: BEFORE_TAX_DEDUCTION_SUBTYPE
description: The types and descriptions of before-tax deductions.  Examples of BEFORE TAX DEDUCTIONs include: - Savings plan – before-tax contributions - Health insurance – associate portion - Dental insurance – associate portion

name: BENEFIT_PLAN
description: Benefit plans are the parts of the total compensation package, other than for pay for time worked, provided to ASSOCIATEs in whole or in part by employer payments.  Benefit plans may be composed of regulated benefits such as social security and unemployment insurance as well as components sponsored

name: BENEFIT_PLAN_ELIGIBILITY_TERM_TYPE
description: This contains the various terms that can be used to determine whether an ASSOCIATE is eligible for benefits. Examples of eligibility terms include six months service and immediate.

name: BENEFIT_RULE_TYPE
description: The algorithm that is used by the Claim Settlement System when determining the claim adjudication amounts.

name: DIRECT_EARNING
description: For an ASSOCIATE PAYROLL TRANSACTION, direct earnings refer to various types of compensation that are paid directly in the form of cash or financial instrument. Examples of direct earnings include regular earnings (e.g., standard wages, and overtime), variable earnings (e.g., bonus, and commission),

name: DIRECT_EARNINGS_FINANCIAL_INSTRUMENT
description: If an employee is paid via a financial instrument that is not cash then this entity identifies the financial instrument. This would include payments to associates in the form of stock options. This is a subtype of DIRECT EARNING so that regular and variable compensation can be in different forms of

name: DIRECT_EARNING_SUBTYPE
description: This entity further classifies direct earnings or pay received directly in the form of cash. Examples of types of direct earnings include wages, bonuses, and incentives.

name: HEALTH_INSURANCE_INDIRECT_EARNING
description: The employer portion of health insurance paid indirectly as a noncash benefit.

name: INDIRECT_EARNING
description: For an ASSOCIATE PAYROLL TRANSACTION, indirect earning refers to various types of compensation that are paid indirectly through benefits. Examples include pensions, health insurance, and leave.

name: INDIRECT_EARNING_SUBTYPE
description: Classifies indirect earnings into types of compensation that are paid indirectly through benefits.  Examples include pensions, health insurance, and leave.

name: JOB_CLASSIFICATION
description: Describes the general job title or classification of a position. Examples would be teller, customer service rep, branch manager, senior VP, marketing analyst, and product manager.

name: JOB_CLASSIFICATION_LABOR_SHIFT_SCHEDULE
description: This entity specifies for a given location, date, work shift and job classification code, how many regular and overtime hours will be scheduled. A complete schedule for a location can be created by building an entry for each job classification code at that location for a particular date.  Note: Once

name: JOB_LABOR_TASK_CROSS-REFERENCE
description: Specifies all the labor task types than can (or may) be performed by someone within a given job classification.  Example: Bill's job classification code of 25 (Sr. Housekeeper) can have the following labor tasks associated with it: - Housekeeping inspection task - Housekeeping supervision task - Lig

name: LEAVE_INDIRECT_EARNING
description: Earned leave paid indirectly as a noncash benefit.

name: LEAVE_PLAN
description: Describes the various different leave plans that may be offered to associates as part of a benefit plan.

name: MISCELLANEOUS_BENEFIT_PLAN
description: A subtype of BENEFIT PLAN OPTION for various benefits that may not fit in traditional benefit categories. An example might be an employee discount.

name: PAYROLL_BALANCE_TYPE
description: A code that qualifies the PAY STUB BALANCE values.  Examples: - Gross pay - Net pay - Vacation - Sick leave

name: PAYROLL_PAY_PERIOD
description: This entity defines the period of time related to the ASSOCIATE PAYROLL TRANSACTION. For example, there is a two-week pay period associated with a biweekly payroll with 26 paydays.

name: PAYROLL_REGISTER
description: Aggregate record of the monetary amounts for salaries, wages, bonuses, net pay, and deductions paid on a periodic basis by an enterprise to its associates.  Transaction information includes earnings and deduction details, payroll tax obligations, and leave accrual.

name: PENSION_INDIRECT_EARNING
description: An employer pension paid indirectly as a noncash benefit.

name: REGULAR_EARNING
description: This entity captures information related to associate's regular or direct fixed pay received in the form of cash, for example, salary.

name: REGULAR_EARNING_SUBTYPE
description: This is a code for the types of regular earnings, such as: - Standard pay: wage based on a per hour rate or a salary that is paid at regular intervals. - Overtime pay: extra pay that is provided for working more than the standard number of hours or when working holidays or other unique situations.

name: REGULATED_BENEFIT
description: This entity holds information about benefits available to associates in accordance with statutory requirements and government insurance programs. Examples include social security, workers' compensation, and unemployment benefits. In some jurisdictions, these programs require compulsory employer cont

name: REGULATED_BENEFIT_TYPE
description: Defines type codes assigned to REGULATED BENEFITs, for example, Workers' Compensation or State Unemployment Insurance.

name: VARIABLE_EARNING
description: This entity contains information about an associate's variable earnings, or pay received in the form of cash that is tied to productivity or other measure that varies with an organization's profitability. Examples of variable earnings include bonus and incentives.

name: VARIABLE_EARNING_SUBTYPE
description: This is a code for the types of variable earnings such as bonus and commission.

name: WITHHOLDING_TAX
description: This entity holds information about taxes that employers are required to withhold from associates' pay. Types of withholding taxes vary depending on the employer's tax jurisdiction. Examples of withholding taxes include federal income tax, state income tax, and local tax.

name: WITHHOLDING_TAX_SUBTYPE
description: This entity holds information about the types and descriptions of withholding taxes, which vary depending on the employer's tax jurisdiction. Examples of withholding taxes include federal income tax, state income tax, and local tax.

name: WORK_SHIFT_DAILY_HOURS
description: Details the start and duration of a WORK SHIFT TYPE for a group of SITEs by calendar date.

name: WORK_SHIFT_DAY_OF_WEEK_HOURS
description: Details the start and duration of a WORK SHIFT TYPE for a group of SITEs by DAY OF WEEK.

name: WORK_SHIFT_TYPE
description: Denotes the shift a PARTY works at a SITE, for example, day, night, weekdays, and weekends nights.
